hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 separates Jandai [jan] and Yagara [yxg] but they are close enough from a linguistic point of view to count as one language (**hh:ew:ColliverWoolston:Stradbroke**, **hh:hvw:Jefferies:Guwar**). See also: Yagara-Jandai [NOCODE_Yagara].
